darren_customer: Hey team — our account used ~28k embedding credits overnight. We have a scheduled worker that posts batches to /v1/embeddings. We didn't change the job. Any chance this is a server-side retry loop?

maria_support: Sorry to hear that, can you paste the job id and time window? also which API key was used so we can correlate logs. :eyes:

darren_customer: job_id=ingest_2026_11_02_03, window: 2026-11-02 02:45-03:30 UTC. Key is proj-AK-xxxx (will DM full key). We're seeing a ton of `502` in our worker logs and the client lib retries 4 times by default. Worker log snippet: ```2026-11-02T03:01:12Z POST /v1/embeddings 502, retrying (attempt 1)
2026-11-02T03:01:13Z POST /v1/embeddings 502, retrying (attempt 2)
2026-11-02T03:01:14Z POST /v1/embeddings 200, 128 vectors accepted``` We assume retry dedup should be handled by our side, but wondering if server returned a success that we didn't ack and then retried, leading to duplicate billing?

ingest-cron-bot: scheduled job ingest_2026_11_02_03 started 2026-11-02T02:47:02Z, 78 batches queued.

maria_support: Thanks. We can look up the backend request IDs. A couple quick asks: do you send an idempotency key per batch? and are you using our official SDK or a homegrown HTTP retry wrapper?

darren_customer: homegrown wrapper. No idempotency header. We rely on HTTP status only. Code has naive retry on 5xx.

maria_support: That explains possibility of double-consumption. Two failure modes we see: (1) client retries when the server actually accepted the request but timed out before responding, and (2) transient 502s from our edge when a downstream instance was overloaded, and the client retried -> duplicate work. We can correlate request IDs to see which batches were processed twice. Please hang on while we check.

sam_infra: Filing internal trace: looks like at 03:00-03:06 UTC we had elevated 502s in region eu-west-1 due to a worker restart during a config rollout. The control plane retried some upstream calls. Noting: some requests reached the embedding worker and succeeded but response did not make it back to the edge.

tomek_sre: We should mark this as potential credit-impact incident. Maria, can you confirm if we can identify server-side `accepted` events for that job id? If yes, support can offer a manual credit reconciliation while infra fixes the edge flakiness.

maria_support: On it. I see request IDs for your project that show both `accepted` events and duplicate receipts for the same batch checksum. We can produce a list of duplicated batch checksums. Quick mitigation suggestions for customers: 1) use Idempotency-Key per batch, 2) treat 2xx with unknown response as success and avoid blind retries if you can check by checksum, 3) reduce retry attempts when sending large batches.

darren_customer: do you refund or restore credits for duplicates? We lost a lot of trial credits for teammates testing.

maria_support: We do a case-by-case review. For clear duplicates caused by our partial-response failure, we can refund the extra consumed credits or apply a one-off promo credit. Please DM the full API key and the list of affected batch IDs (we'll provide the list). Also we'll patch our observability to emit `x-embed-accepted: 1` in the edge response when backend ack happened so clients can more easily detect acceptance in the future.

sam_infra: follow-up: deploying a small fix to edge timeouts and increasing logging for 502 flows. Deploy started 2026-11-02T04:00:00Z.

ingest-cron-bot: ingest_2026_11_02_03 completed 2026-11-02T03:37:50Z, 78 batches processed.

darren_customer: Appreciate the quick triage. Two quick asks: can support (1) give a list of duplicated batch checksums so we can dedupe locally and (2) either refund or credit the trial balance while you investigate?

maria_support: We'll generate the dup list and DM you. For the credit: provisional credit applied to your trial balance + follow-up audit. We'll confirm exact amount in DM. :white_check_mark:

tomek_sre: action items: (a) infra to finish edge fix and monitor 502 rate for 24h, (b) add an edge header for ack detection, (c) support to process credits for confirmed duplicates. I'll link postmortem if incident qualifies.

darren_customer: thanks all. one more note — we'll add idempotency keys and checksum verification on our side immediately.

maria_support: Thanks, and please send the key + batch ids in DM. We'll close after the audit and crediting completes. :pray:
